title: Hot Springs
description: Count valid spring arrangements matching damaged group patterns.
writeup:
## Approach

For each row, count how many ways the `?` characters can be replaced with `#` or `.` such that the resulting contiguous groups of `#` match the given group sizes.

## Part 1

Use dynamic programming with memoization. The state is `(position_in_pattern, current_group_index)`. At each position, try skipping (`.`) or starting a group (`#`). When starting a group, verify the next `g` characters can all be `#` and the character after is not `#`.

## Part 2

Unfold each row 5 times (pattern joined with `?`, groups repeated 5x). The same DP works efficiently because `lru_cache` avoids recomputing overlapping subproblems across the expanded pattern.
